description: Allow shoppers to check out as guests instead of creating an account before payment.
Require shoppers to create an account and complete a profile before reaching payment.
Pre-fill known delivery details and remove two optional fields from the checkout form.
Add a mandatory preferences screen between the basket and payment pages.
Compress product images to reduce initial page loading time without changing the page layout.
Cache category-page responses so repeat requests load faster, keeping the content unchanged.
Defer off-screen scripts to improve mobile page loading without altering the purchase flow.
Fix an intermittent checkout issue where the first tap on the submit button is ignored.
Fix a rare postcode-validation error that rejects valid payment details.
Preserve basket contents when shoppers return from a product page instead of making them start again.
